passive.name: Pyromania
passive.description: Annie's offensive spells occasionally Stuns her target(s).

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.description: Annie hurls a mana-infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the mana cost if it destroys the target.

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.description: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

spells.name: Molten Shield
spells.description: Increases Annie's Armor and Magic Resist and damages enemies who hit Annie with basic attacks.

spells.name: Summon: Tibbers
spells.description: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.description: Olaf's Attack Speed increases as his Health decreases.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to units it passes through and slowing their movement speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Vicious Strikes
spells.description: Olaf's attack damage is increased, based on his health, and he gains massive lifesteal and spell vamp.

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself.

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.description: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to disables and gains bonus Armor, Magic Resist, and Lethality.

passive.name: Runic Skin
passive.description: Galio converts Magic Resistance into Ability Power.

spells.name: Resolute Smite
spells.description: Galio fires a concussive blast from his eyes, slowing and dealing damage to enemies caught near the impact point.

spells.name: Bulwark
spells.description: Galio shields an ally Champion, increasing their Armor and Magic Resistance, and restoring Galio's health each time that Champion suffers damage.

spells.name: Righteous Gust
spells.description: Galio claps his wings, unleashing a gust of concussive wind that damages enemies and leaves a directional draft in its wake that increases ally movement speed.

spells.name: Idol of Durand
spells.description: Galio assumes the form of a statue, taunting nearby enemies and storing concussive energy as they attack him. Galio then bursts from his statue shell, releasing the stored energy to damage surrounding foes.

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.description: Twisted Fate and his allies receive an additional gold per kill.

spells.name: Wild Cards
spells.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

spells.name: Pick A Card
spells.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

spells.name: Gate
spells.description: After channeling, Twisted Fate Teleports to any target location.

spells.name: Destiny
spells.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing and slowing all enemy champions. Gate's channel time is also reduced during this duration.

passive.name: Challenge
passive.description: Xin Zhao challenges his target with his basic attacks and Audacious Charge, reducing its armor by 15% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage that reduce his other ability cooldowns, with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

spells.name: Battle Cry
spells.description: Xin Zhao passively heals every 3 attacks and can activate this ability to attack faster.

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.description: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.

spells.name: Crescent Sweep
spells.description: Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back. Xin Zhao gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist based on number of champions hit.

passive.name: Echoing Flames
passive.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

spells.name: Corrosive Charge
spells.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

spells.name: Purge
spells.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

spells.name: Disdain
spells.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

spells.name: Fear Beyond Death
spells.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

passive.name: Mirror Image
passive.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

spells.name: Sigil of Malice
spells.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

spells.name: Distortion
spells.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

spells.name: Ethereal Chains
spells.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

spells.name: Mimic
spells.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

spells.name: Transfusion
spells.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

spells.name: Sanguine Pool
spells.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

spells.name: Tides of Blood
spells.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

spells.name: Hemoplague
spells.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

passive.name: Dread
passive.description: Nearby enemies have reduced Magic Resist.

spells.name: Terrify
spells.description: Strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

spells.name: Drain
spells.description: Fiddlesticks saps the life force of an enemy, dealing damage to a target over time and healing himself.

spells.name: Dark Wind
spells.description: A wisp of wind strikes an enemy unit and then bounces to nearby enemy units, dealing damage and silencing the victims.

spells.name: Crowstorm
spells.description: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage each second to all enemy units in the area.

passive.name: Holy Fervor
passive.description: Kayle gains a percentage of her Ability Power as Attack damage and a percentage of her Attack Damage as Ability Power.

spells.name: Reckoning
spells.description: Kayle blasts a target, dealing damage, slowing their movement speed, and applying a stack of Holy Fervor.

spells.name: Divine Blessing
spells.description: Kayle blesses an allied champion, increasing their movement speed and healing them.

spells.name: Righteous Fury
spells.description: Kayle increases her attack range and her basic attacks deals additional damage to her target and nearby enemies.

spells.name: Intervention
spells.description: Bathes Kayle's target in a holy light, rendering them immune to all damage for a short time.

passive.name: Double Strike
passive.description: Master Yi occassionaly strikes twice.

spells.name: Alpha Strike
spells.description: Master Yi leaps across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path. Alpha strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to minions and monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

spells.name: Meditate
spells.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.

spells.name: Wuju Style
spells.description: Master Yi becomes skilled in the art of Wuju, passively increasing his Attack Damage. Activating Wuju Style grants bonus true damage on basic attacks, but the passive bonus is then lost while on cooldown.

spells.name: Highlander
spells.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Movement and Attack speeds as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extends Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

passive.name: Trample
passive.description: Each time Alistar casts a spell, he Tramples nearby units and turrets for a few seconds, dealing damage to units he walks over.

spells.name: Pulverize
spells.description: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to all nearby enemies and tossing them into the air. On landing, enemies are stunned.

spells.name: Headbutt
spells.description: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

spells.name: Triumphant Roar
spells.description: Alistar lets out a commanding war cry, restoring health to himself and nearby allies. Nearby enemy deaths reduce the cooldown.

spells.name: Unbreakable Will
spells.description: Alistar lets out a wild roar, gaining bonus damage, removing all crowd-control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

passive.name: Arcane Mastery
passive.description: Ryze's abilities reduce the cooldown of all other abilities.

spells.name: Overload
spells.description: Passive: Ryze permanently gains Cooldown Reduction.Active: Ryze unleashes an orb of energy, dealing magic damage to his target.

spells.name: Rune Prison
spells.description: Ryze magically imprisons an enemy, rooting them and dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Spell Flux
spells.description: Ryze fires a chaotic bolt of magic that can bounce between enemies, dealing magic damage and reducing their Magic Resist.

spells.name: Desperate Power
spells.description: Ryze temporary harnesses his full powers, gaining area of effect damage on all abilities, Spell Vamp, and Move Speed for a short time.

passive.name: Feel No Pain
passive.description: Sion has a chance to ignore some damage each time he is attacked.

spells.name: Cryptic Gaze
spells.description: Sion's stare terrifies a single enemy, dealing damage and stunning them.

spells.name: Death's Caress
spells.description: Sion surrounds himself with a damage-absorbing shield. If the shield is not destroyed it will explode, damaging surrounding enemies. Sion can reactivate the ability to detonate the shield early.

spells.name: Enrage
spells.description: While active Sion gains Attack Damage at the cost of Health on each basic attack. Additonally, he permanently increases his maximum Health whenever he kills a unit.

spells.name: Cannibalism
spells.description: Sion consumes some of his enemies' life force on each attack, leeching health to himself and nearby allies. The smell of flesh also renews Sion's fervor, increasing his Attack Speed.

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Movement Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.description: Sivir's next basic attack will bounce between targets, dealing reduced damage with each successive hit.

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.description: Sivir creates a magical barrier on herself that blocks a single enemy ability. She regains Mana if an ability is successfully blocked.

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.description: Sivir leads her allies into battle granting them increased Movement and Attack Speeds for a period of time.

passive.name: Consecration
passive.description: Increases surrounding allies' Magic Resist.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.description: A shower of stars falls from the sky, striking all nearby enemies for magic damage and reducing their Magic Resist for a short duration.

spells.name: Astral Blessing
spells.description: Soraka blesses a friendly unit, restoring health and increasing Armor for a short time.

spells.name: Infuse
spells.description: Restores Mana to an ally, or deals damage to an enemy and silences them for a short duration.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all friendly champions.

passive.name: Camouflage
passive.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

spells.name: Blinding Dart
spells.description: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

spells.name: Move Quick
spells.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his movement speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus movement speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

spells.name: Toxic Shot
spells.description: Each of Teemo's attacks poisons the target, dealing damage on impact and over time.

spells.name: Noxious Trap
spells.description: Teemo places an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time.

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.description: Increases Tristana's attack range as she levels.

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her attack speed for a short time.

spells.name: Rocket Jump
spells.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel herself to a distant location, damaging and slowing enemies where she lands.

spells.name: Explosive Shot
spells.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to deal damage to target unit over time, and reduce healing received.

spells.name: Buster Shot
spells.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals magic damage and knocks the target back.

passive.name: Eternal Thirst
passive.description: Each of Warwick's attacks will heal him. Each successive attack against the same target will steal more and more Health.

spells.name: Hungering Strike
spells.description: Takes a bite out of an enemy unit and heals Warwick.

spells.name: Hunter's Call
spells.description: Warwick lets out a howl, increasing all friendly champions' Attack Speed for a short time.

spells.name: Blood Scent
spells.description: Warwick passively senses weakened enemy champions around him. The scent of blood sends him into a fury, causing him to move at incredible speeds.

spells.name: Infinite Duress
spells.description: Warwick lunges at an enemy champion, suppressing his target and dealing magic damage for a few seconds.

passive.name: Visionary
passive.description: Nunu can cast a spell for free after several attacks.

spells.name: Consume
spells.description: Nunu commands the yeti to take a bite out of a target minion or monster, dealing heavy damage to it and healing himself.

spells.name: Blood Boil
spells.description: Nunu invigorates himself and an allied unit by heating their blood, increasing their Movement and Attack Speeds.

spells.name: Ice Blast
spells.description: Nunu launches a ball of ice at an enemy unit, dealing damage and temporarily slowing their Movement and Attack Speeds.

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.description: Nunu begins to sap the area of heat, slowing all nearby enemies. When the spell ends, he deals massive damage to all enemies caught in the area.

passive.name: Strut
passive.description: Miss Fortune has increased Movement Speed until she is hit in combat.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them.

spells.name: Impure Shots
spells.description: Miss Fortune passively increases damage dealt to a target with each strike. This ability can be activated to increase Miss Fortune's Attack Speed and cause her attacks to lower healing received by the target.

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.description: Miss Fortune unleashes a flurry of bullets at a location, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.description: Miss Fortune channels a flurry of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies.

passive.name: Focus
passive.description: Ashe gains stacks of Focus while out-of-combat. When Ashe has 100 stacks of Focus, her next basic Attack will critically strike.

spells.name: Frost Shot
spells.description: While active, each of Ashe's basic attacks slow her targets. This drains Mana with each attack.

spells.name: Volley
spells.description: Ashe fires 7 arrows in a cone for increased damage. Volley also applies Ashe's current level of Frost Shot.

spells.name: Hawkshot
spells.description: Each time Ashe kills a unit, she gains some extra gold. Ashe can activate to send her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission.

spells.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
spells.description: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion for up to 3.5 seconds, based on how far the arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.description: Tryndamere gains bonus critical strike chance, increased by his missing Health.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, gaining Fury that increasing his Attack and Critical Strike Damage as he kills enemies and deals critical strikes. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

spells.name: Mocking Shout
spells.description: Tryndamere mocks nearby champions for their cowardice, reducing their Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Movement Speed reduced.

spells.name: Spinning Slash
spells.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

spells.name: Undying Rage
spells.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

passive.name: Equipment Mastery
passive.description: Jax's gains bonus Health based on his bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power from items.

spells.name: Leap Strike
spells.description: Jax leaps and strikes.

spells.name: Empower
spells.description: Jax's next attack or Leap Strike deals bonus damage and damages nearby enemies.

spells.name: Counter Strike
spells.description: Jax enters a defensive stance, dodging all incoming basic attacks and taking less damage from area of effect abilities. Then he stuns surrounding enemies and damages them.

spells.name: Relentless Assault
spells.description: Jax gains attack speed when he strikes. Every third consecutive attack deals bonus damage.

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.description: Morgana has Spell Vamp, healing herself whenever she deals damage with her spells.

spells.name: Dark Binding
spells.description: Morgana releases a sphere of dark magic. Upon contact with an enemy unit, the sphere will deal magic damage and force the unit to the ground for a period of time.

spells.name: Tormented Soil
spells.description: Infects an area with desecrated soil, causing enemy units who stand on the location to take continual damage.

spells.name: Black Shield
spells.description: Places a protective barrier around an allied champion, absorbing magical damage and disables until penetrated or the shield dissipates.

spells.name: Soul Shackles
spells.description: Latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions, dealing initial damage to them and slowing their Movement Speed, and then echoing the pain a few seconds later and stunning them if they remain close to Morgana.

passive.name: Heightened Learning
passive.description: Zilean and his allies gain additional experience.

spells.name: Time Bomb
spells.description: Zilean places a time bomb on his target, which damages nearby enemies once it expires.

spells.name: Rewind
spells.description: Zilean reduces all of his other cooldowns.

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.description: Zilean increases an allied Champion's movement speed or slows an enemy champion.

spells.name: Chronoshift
spells.description: Zilean marks himself or an allied champion with a protective time rune. If they would take lethal damage, they are instead transported back in time and healed.

passive.name: Empowered Bulwark
passive.description: Increases Singed's Health based on his maximum Mana.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing enemies who walk on it.

spells.name: Fling
spells.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed.

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats.

passive.name: Shadow Walk
passive.description: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Camoflauge only being able to be seen by nearby enemy champions or true sight. While stealthed, she rapidly regenerates Mana.

spells.name: Hate Spike
spells.description: Evelynn fires a line of spikes through an enemy, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.

spells.name: Dark Frenzy
spells.description: Evelynn passively increases her Movement Speed when hitting enemy champions with her spells. Upon activation, Evelynn breaks free from slows affecting her and gains a massive Movement Speed boost for a short duration.

spells.name: Ravage
spells.description: Evelynn slashes her target twice, dealing damage with each hit. She then gains increased Attack Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Agony's Embrace
spells.description: Evelynn summons spikes from the ground to deal damage and slow enemies in the area. She then gains a shield based on how many enemy champions were hit.

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target, dealing magic damage each second.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Twitch turns Invisible for several seconds, gaining Move Speed. He then gains Attack Speed after coming out of Invisibility.

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes, inflicting Deadly Venom and slowing enemies in the area.

spells.name: Expunge
spells.description: All nearby enemies secrete Twitch's toxic venoms from their bodies, dealing damage for each stack.

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.description: Twitch closes his eyes and fires his crossbow, rapidly spraying powerful piercing bolts ahead of him.

passive.name: Death Defied
passive.description: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form allowing him to continue casting spells while dead for a short time.

spells.name: Lay Waste
spells.description: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Wall of Pain
spells.description: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy. Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Movement Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.

spells.name: Defile
spells.description: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill. Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own mana.

spells.name: Requiem
spells.description: After channeling, Karthus damages all enemy champions.

passive.name: Carnivore
passive.description: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers health and mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

spells.name: Rupture
spells.description: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

spells.name: Feral Scream
spells.description: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

spells.name: Vorpal Spikes
spells.description: Cho'Gath's attacks passively release deadly spikes, dealing damage to all enemy units in front of him.

spells.name: Feast
spells.description: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum health (maximum 6 stacks). Cho'Gath loses half of his stacks upon death.

passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.description: Amumu's attacks reduce his target's Magic Resist.

spells.name: Bandage Toss
spells.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

spells.name: Despair
spells.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum health each second.

spells.name: Tantrum
spells.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

spells.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
spells.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.description: Rammus gains additional damage as his shell becomes reinforced, converting a portion of his Armor into Attack Damage.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his armor and magic resistance, while returning damage to attacks.

spells.name: Puncturing Taunt
spells.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against Rammus' hard shell, reducing Armor temporarily.

spells.name: Tremors
spells.description: Rammus creates waves of destruction pulsing through the ground, causing damage to units and structures near him.

passive.name: Rebirth
passive.description: Upon dying, Anivia will revert into an egg. If the egg can survive, she is gloriously reborn.

spells.name: Flash Frost
spells.description: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

spells.name: Crystallize
spells.description: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing a medium amount of damage. If the target has been slowed by an ice effect, the damage they take is doubled.

spells.name: Glacial Storm
spells.description: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

passive.name: Backstab
passive.description: Shaco's Attacks and abilities deal bonus damage from behind.

spells.name: Deceive
spells.description: Shaco becomes invisible and teleports to target location. His next attack is guaranteed to critically strike.

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.description: Shaco creates an animated Jack-in-the-Box at target location, which will wait, invisible, to Fear nearby units and attack them when some come nearby.

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing them and applying a miss chance to minions. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target.

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies. Upon death, it explodes, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

passive.name: Adrenaline Rush
passive.description: Dr. Mundo regenerates a portion of his maximum Health each second.

spells.name: Infected Cleaver
spells.description: Dr. Mundo hurls his cleaver, dealing damage based on his victims maximum health.

spells.name: Burning Agony
spells.description: Dr. Mundo drains his health to reduce the duration of disables and deal continual damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Masochism
spells.description: Dr. Mundo's gains Attack Damage for a few seconds based on his missing health.

spells.name: Sadism
spells.description: Dr. Mundo sacrifices a portion of his Health for increased Movement Speed and drastically increased Health Regeneration.

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.description: Every few spells, Sona's next attack deals bonus magic damage and causes her target to deal reduced damage for a few seconds.

spells.name: Hymn of Valor
spells.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, granting nearby allied champions bonus Damage and Ability Power. Additionally, casting this ability sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to the nearest two enemy champions or monsters.

spells.name: Aria of Perseverance
spells.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, granting nearby allied champions bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Additionally, casting this ability sends out healing melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally.

spells.name: Song of Celerity
spells.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allied champions bonus Movement Speed. Additionally, casting this ability energizes nearby allies with a burst of speed.

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, forcing enemy champions to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

passive.name: Void Stone
passive.description: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and transforms incoming magic damage into bonus Attack Speed.

spells.name: Null Sphere
spells.description: Kassadin fires an ethereal bolt of void energy, dealing damage and silencing the target for a duration.

spells.name: Nether Blade
spells.description: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks restore Mana. Active: Kassadin's basic attacks deal additional magic damage.

spells.name: Force Pulse
spells.description: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

spells.name: Riftwalk
spells.description: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Additionally, multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana and deal additional damage.

passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

spells.name: Bladesurge
spells.description: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

spells.name: Defiant Dance
spells.description: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

spells.name: Flawless Duet
spells.description: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.

spells.name: Vanguard's Edge
spells.description: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.

passive.name: Tailwind
passive.description: Janna and her allied champions gain increased Movement Speed.

spells.name: Howling Gale
spells.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can active the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

spells.name: Zephyr
spells.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Movement Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Movement Speed. The passive is lost while this ability is on cooldown.

spells.name: Eye Of The Storm
spells.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

spells.name: Monsoon
spells.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

passive.name: Grog-Soaked Blade
passive.description: Gangplank's attacks apply a poison that deals magic damage per second, increasing with level.

spells.name: Parrrley
spells.description: Gangplank takes aim and shoots an enemy unit with his pistol. If Parrrley deals a killing blow, he gains extra gold and half the mana cost is refunded.

spells.name: Remove Scurvy
spells.description: Consumes a large quantity of citrus fruit which clears any crowd control effects on him and heals him.

spells.name: Raise Morale
spells.description: Gangplank fires a shot into the air, increasing nearby allied champions' attack damage and movement speed.

spells.name: Cannon Barrage
spells.description: Gangplank signals his ship to fire upon an area anywhere on the map, slowing enemies and dealing damage over time.

passive.name: Hextech Shrapnel Shells
passive.description: Corki's basic attacks deal bonus true damage to minions, monsters, and champions.

spells.name: Phosphorus Bomb
spells.description: Corki fires a bomb, damaging and revealing enemies around the blast.

spells.name: Valkyrie
spells.description: Corki surges to target location, dropping bombs that create a trail of destruction for opponents who remain in the fire.

spells.name: Gatling Gun
spells.description: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy armor.

spells.name: Missile Barrage
spells.description: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Some missiles will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

passive.name: Gathering Fire
passive.description: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

spells.name: Inner Flame
spells.description: Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

spells.name: Focused Resolve
spells.description: Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

spells.name: Inspire
spells.description: Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

spells.name: Mantra
spells.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

passive.name: Gemcraft
passive.description: Taric loves to socket magical gems into all of his weapons, resulting in his basic attacks dealing bonus magic damage based on his maximum Mana.

spells.name: Imbue
spells.description: Taric brings forth earthen energy to heal an ally and himself. This heal is more potent when Taric heals only himself. Additionally,Taric's basic attacks reduce Imbue's cooldown.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: Taric is protected by a hardening aura, increasing the Armor of himself and nearby allied champions. He may choose to splinter the enchanted rocks surrounding him to deal damage and decrease the Armor of nearby enemies at the cost of some Armor for a short time.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.description: Taric emits a brilliant ball of prismatic light from his gemmed shield, stunning his target and damaging them based on how close he is to them.

spells.name: Radiance
spells.description: Taric slams his hammer into the ground to deal damage to nearby enemies. For a time after, Taric's gems radiate energy empowering Taric and his allies with bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power

passive.name: Equilibrium
passive.description: Veigar's mana regeneration increases based on his missing mana.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.description: Unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing magic damage. If a unit is killed, Veigar gains some Ability Power permanently.

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands.

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.description: Veigar twists the edges of space around the target location for 3 seconds, stunning enemies who pass through the perimeter for a short duration.

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large base amount of magic damage plus 80% of his target's AP.

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

spells.name: Demonic Ascension
spells.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

passive.name: Headshot
passive.description: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

spells.name: Piltover Peacemaker
spells.description: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

spells.name: Yordle Snap Trap
spells.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

spells.name: 90 Caliber Net
spells.description: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

spells.name: Ace in the Hole
spells.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

passive.name: Mana Barrier
passive.description: When taking damage at low Health, Blitzcrank is first Shielded for a percent of their current Mana. This effect has a cooldown.

spells.name: Rocket Grab
spells.description: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

spells.name: Overdrive
spells.description: Blitzcrank supercharges themself to get dramatically increased movement and attack speed.

spells.name: Power Fist
spells.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make their next attack deal bonus damage and pop their target up in the air.

spells.name: Static Field
spells.description: Passively causes lightning bolts to damage a nearby enemy. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to damage nearby enemies and briefly silence them.

passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage. If Malphite has not been hit recently, this effect recharges.

spells.name: Seismic Shard
spells.description: Using his primal elemental magic, Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing their movement speed.

spells.name: Brutal Strikes
spells.description: Malphite starts to hit with such force that his attacks deal damage to all units in front of him. Activating Brutal Strikes greatly increases his Armor and Attack Damage for a short amount of time.

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.description: Malphite slams the ground sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor as damage and reduces the Attack speed of enemies for a short duration.

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.description: Malphite ferociously charges to a location, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

passive.name: Voracity
passive.description: Champion takedowns reduce Katarina's cooldowns.

spells.name: Bouncing Blade
spells.description: Katarina throws a dagger that bounces from enemy to enemy, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Sinister Steel
spells.description: Katarina whirls her daggers around her, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area. If she hits an enemy Champion, Katarina gains a burst of speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Shunpo
spells.description: Katarina instantly moves to her target's location and takes reduced damage from enemies for a few seconds. If the target is an enemy, she deals damage.

spells.name: Death Lotus
spells.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers with unrivaled speed at nearby enemy Champions, dealing significant damage and applying Wounds.

passive.name: Umbra Blades
passive.description: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

spells.name: Duskbringer
spells.description: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

spells.name: Shroud of Darkness
spells.description: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

spells.name: Unspeakable Horror
spells.description: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

spells.name: Paranoia
spells.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

passive.name: Sap Magic
passive.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Bramble Smash
spells.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

spells.name: Twisted Advance
spells.description: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

spells.name: Sapling Toss
spells.description: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

passive.name: Reign of Anger
passive.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

spells.name: Cull the Meek
spells.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

spells.name: Ruthless Predator
spells.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Slice and Dice
spells.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

spells.name: Dominus
spells.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

passive.name: Martial Cadence
passive.description: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

spells.name: Dragon Strike
spells.description: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of all enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

spells.name: Golden Aegis
spells.description: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Demacian Standard
spells.description: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed and Armor. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.

spells.name: Cataclysm
spells.description: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them.

passive.name: Spider Queen
passive.description: Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

spells.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
spells.description: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

spells.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
spells.description: Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.

spells.name: Cocoon / Rappel
spells.description: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

spells.name: Spider Form
spells.description: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

passive.name: Clockwork Windup
passive.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

spells.name: Command: Attack
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

spells.name: Command: Dissonance
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

spells.name: Command: Protect
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

spells.name: Command: Shockwave
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.description: Increases Wukong's armor and magic resistance for each nearby enemy champion.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.description: Wukong's next attack gains extra range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the enemy's Armor.

spells.name: Decoy
spells.description: Wukong becomes invisible and spawns an uncontrollable decoy that will damage nearby enemies after a short delay.

spells.name: Nimbus Strike
spells.description: Wukong dashes toward a target enemy and sends out images to attack up to 2 additional enemies near his target, dealing physical damage to each enemy struck.

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.description: Wukong's staff grows outward and he spins it around, dealing damage and knocking up enemies. Wukong gains movement speed over the duration of the spell.

passive.name: Blaze
passive.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing a portion of their maximum Health in magic damage.

spells.name: Sear
spells.description: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

spells.name: Pillar of Flame
spells.description: After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units with the area. Units that are ablaze take additional damage

spells.name: Conflagration
spells.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing magic damage to them. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Pyroclasm
spells.description: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire, dealing magic damage each time it bounces. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will priotize champions for the next bounce.

passive.name: Flurry
passive.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

spells.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
spells.description: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, damaging the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike.Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing more damage plus a portion of their missing health.

spells.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
spells.description: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes towards a target ally, shielding them both from damage. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle, gaining Life Steal, Spell Vamp, and Armor.

spells.name: Tempest / Cripple
spells.description: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple for the next 3 seconds.Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies revealed by Tempest, reducing their Movement and Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Movement and Attack Speed recover gradually over the duration.

spells.name: Dragon's Rage
spells.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers. She gains bonus Movement Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's maximum Health as bonus true damage.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, dealing damage and knocking them back. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, invisibility during Tumble, and greatly increased bonus Movement Speed from Night Hunter.

passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

spells.name: Flamespitter
spells.description: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

spells.name: Scrap Shield
spells.description: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

spells.name: Electro Harpoon
spells.description: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

spells.name: The Equalizer
spells.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

passive.name: Serpentine Grace
passive.description: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.

spells.name: Noxious Blast
spells.description: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.

spells.name: Miasma
spells.description: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.

spells.name: Twin Fang
spells.description: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.

spells.name: Petrifying Gaze
spells.description: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.

passive.name: Energize
passive.description: Basic attacks reduce all ability cooldowns. This effect is stronger against champions.

spells.name: Crystal Slash
spells.description: Skarner lashes out with his claws, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies and charging himself with Crystal Energy for several seconds if a unit is struck. If he casts Crystal Slash again while powered by Crystal Energy, he deals bonus magic damage and slows all targets hit.

spells.name: Crystalline Exoskeleton
spells.description: Skarner gains a shield, and while the shield persists his movement speed and attack speed are both increased.

spells.name: Fracture
spells.description: Skarner summons a blast of crystalline energy which deals damage to enemies struck and marks them. Striking enemies will consume the mark to heal Skarner. Killing targets outright will also activate the heal.

spells.name: Impale
spells.description: Skarner suppresses an enemy champion and deals magic damage to it. During this time, Skarner can move freely and will drag his helpless victim around with him. When the effect ends, Skarner's target will be dealt additional damage.

passive.name: Techmaturgical Repair Bots
passive.description: Heimerdinger gives nearby allied Turrets and Champions increased Health Regeneration.

spells.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
spells.description: Heimerdinger lays down a machine gun turret. Turrets gain abilities as this skill is increased. (Turrets deal half damage to towers).

spells.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
spells.description: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that hit the enemies closest to Heimerdinger.

spells.name: CH-1 Concussion Grenade
spells.description: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units as well as stunning anyone directly hit and blinding surrounding units.

spells.name: UPGRADE!!!
spells.description: Passive / Active: Passively increases Cooldown Reduction. Activate to heal all active Evolution Turrets and cause them to fire frost shots, which reduce Movement Speed, for a short time.

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Lifesteal.

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

spells.name: Wither
spells.description: Nasus ages his target, decelerating their Movement and Attack Speeds over time.

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

spells.name: Fury of the Sands
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, cast ranges, and drains nearby enemies' max Health converting into bonus damage for the duration.

passive.name: Prowl
passive.description: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Movement Speed.

spells.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies. As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

spells.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee lays a damaging trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages, reveals, reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. As a cougar, she pounces forward, dealing a small amount of damage when she lands.

spells.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with attack speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she rapidly claws enemies in front of her.

spells.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
spells.description: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities and increased Movement Speed.

passive.name: Bridge Between
passive.description: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

spells.name: Wilding Claw
spells.description: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

spells.name: Iron Mantle
spells.description: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

spells.name: Blazing Stampede
spells.description: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

spells.name: Wingborne Storm
spells.description: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.

passive.name: Valiant Fighter
passive.description: All physical and magic damage dealt to Poppy that exceeds 10% of her current health is reduced by 50%. This does not reduce damage from structures.

spells.name: Devastating Blow
spells.description: Poppy crushes her opponent, dealing attack damage plus a flat amount and 8% of her target's max health as bonus damage. The bonus damage cannot exceed a threshold based on rank.

spells.name: Paragon of Demacia
spells.description: Passive: Upon receiving damage from or dealing damage with a basic attack, Poppy's armor and damage are increased for 5 seconds. This effect can stack 10 times. Active: Poppy gains max stacks of Paragon of Demacia and her movement speed is increased for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.description: Poppy charges at an enemy and carries them further. The initial impact deals a small amount of damage, and if they collide with terrain, her target will take a high amount of damage and be stunned.

spells.name: Diplomatic Immunity
spells.description: Poppy focuses intently on a single enemy champion, dealing increased damage to them. Poppy is immune to any damage and abilities from enemies other than her target.

passive.name: Happy Hour
passive.description: On ability use, Gragas takes a drink, restoring some of his Health.

spells.name: Barrel Roll
spells.description: Gragas rolls a barrel that explodes after a short delay, damaging and slowing Attack Speed. Recast to detonate the barrel early.

spells.name: Drunken Rage
spells.description: Gragas guzzles down brew from his cask, restoring Mana. He then gains Attack Damage and reduces damage taken for several seconds.

spells.name: Body Slam
spells.description: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, damaging nearby enemies and Slowing them.

spells.name: Explosive Cask
spells.description: Gragas hurls his cask, damaging and Knocking Away enemies from the impact.

passive.name: Aegis Protection
passive.description: After every @AttacksRequired@ attacks or spell casts, Pantheon gains protection from the next attack.

spells.name: Spear Shot
spells.description: Pantheon hurls his spear at an opponent, dealing damage.

spells.name: Aegis of Zeonia
spells.description: Pantheon leaps at an enemy and bashes the enemy with his shield, stunning them. After finishing the attack, Pantheon readies himself to block the next attack.

spells.name: Heartseeker Strike
spells.description: Pantheon focuses and unleashes swift strikes to the area in front of him, dealing increased damage to champions. Pantheon also becomes more aware of his enemy's vital spots, allowing him to critically strike against wounded enemies.

spells.name: Grand Skyfall
spells.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air to a target, striking all enemy units in an area. Enemies closer to the impact point take more damage.

passive.name: Rising Spell Force
passive.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell.

spells.name: Mystic Shot
spells.description: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

spells.name: Essence Flux
spells.description: Ezreal fires a fluctuating wave of energy, decreasing the Attack Speed and dealing magic damage to enemy champions, while healing and increasing the Attack Speed of allied champions.

spells.name: Arcane Shift
spells.description: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit.

spells.name: Trueshot Barrage
spells.description: Ezreal fires a powerful barrage of energy missiles which do massive damage to each unit it passes through.

passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

spells.name: Obliterate
spells.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

spells.name: Indestructible
spells.description: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

spells.name: Death's Grasp
spells.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

spells.name: Realm of Death
spells.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

passive.name: Shepherd of Souls
passive.description: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Last Rites
spells.description: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

spells.name: Dark Procession
spells.description: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

spells.name: Mourning Mist
spells.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

spells.name: Eulogy of the Isles
spells.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

passive.name: Twin Disciplines
passive.description: Gain damage on hit based on ability powerGain spell vamp based on attack damage

spells.name: Mark of the Assassin
spells.description: Akali spins her kama at a target enemy to deal magic damage and mark the target. Akali's next melee attack against a marked target will consume the mark to cause additional damage and restore Energy.

spells.name: Twilight Shroud
spells.description: Akali throws down a cover of smoke. While inside the area, Akali gains Armor and Magic Resist and becomes invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her. Enemies inside the smoke have their Movement Speed reduced.

spells.name: Crescent Slash
spells.description: Akali flourishes her kamas, dealing damage based on her Attack Damage and Ability Power.

spells.name: Shadow Dance
spells.description: Akali moves through shadows to quickly strike her target, dealing damage and consuming an Essence of Shadow charge. Akali recharges Essence of Shadow charges both periodically and upon kills and assists, max 3 stacks.

passive.name: Mark of the Storm
passive.description: Kennen marks enemies when hitting them with abilities. Once three marks are applied the target is stunned.

spells.name: Thundering Shuriken
spells.description: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of Storm to any opponent that it hits.

spells.name: Electrical Surge
spells.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

spells.name: Lightning Rush
spells.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units. Any enemy unit he runs through takes damage and gets a Mark of the Storm.

spells.name: Slicing Maelstrom
spells.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at random nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

passive.name: Perseverance
passive.description: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

spells.name: Decisive Strike
spells.description: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

spells.name: Courage
spells.description: Garen performs a dance of death with his sword, dealing damage around him for the duration.

spells.name: Judgment
spells.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Demacian Justice
spells.description: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

passive.name: Sunlight
passive.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight debuff to deal additional damage.

spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Armor and Magic Resistance. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

spells.name: Zenith Blade
spells.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

passive.name: Summon Voidling
passive.description: Every few spells, Malzahar summons an uncontrollable Voidling to engage his enemies. Voidlings grow over time, gaining armor, damage, and attack speed.

spells.name: Call of the Void
spells.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

spells.name: Null Zone
spells.description: Malzahar creates a zone of negative energy that damages nearby enemies each second.

spells.name: Malefic Visions
spells.description: Malzahar infects his target's mind, dealing damage over time. If the target dies during this time, the visions pass to a nearby enemy and Malzahar gains mana.

spells.name: Nether Grasp
spells.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress target champion while dealing magic damage over time.

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

spells.name: Noxian Diplomacy
spells.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

spells.name: Rake
spells.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

spells.name: Assassin's Path
spells.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

spells.name: Shadow Assault
spells.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

passive.name: Runic Blade
passive.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

spells.name: Broken Wings
spells.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

spells.name: Ki Burst
spells.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

spells.name: Valor
spells.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

spells.name: Blade of the Exile
spells.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.description: Upon dying, Kog'Maw starts a chain reaction in his body which causes him to detonate after a few seconds, damaging surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Caustic Spittle
spells.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile that damages his target and corrodes their Armor and Magic Resist.

spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.

spells.name: Void Ooze
spells.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

spells.name: Living Artillery
spells.description: Kog'Maw fires a living artillery shell at a great distance dealing damage and revealing targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional mana.

passive.name: Ki Strike
passive.description: Periodically, Shen's next attack deals bonus damage. Each time Shen attacks a minion, monster, or champion, Ki Strike's cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Vorpal Blade
spells.description: Damages target unit and life taps him, healing allies that attack the target.

spells.name: Feint
spells.description: Shen shields himself, absorbing incoming damage for a few seconds.

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes rapidly toward a target location, taunting enemy champions he encounters and dealing minor damage.

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

passive.name: Illumination
passive.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Light Binding
spells.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

spells.name: Prismatic Barrier
spells.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

spells.name: Lucent Singularity
spells.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

spells.name: Finales Funkeln
spells.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.description: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.description: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.description: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.description: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

passive.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
passive.description: Shyvana's basic attacks enhance her abilities.

spells.name: Twin Bite
spells.description: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by 0.5 seconds. Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front Shyvana.

spells.name: Burnout
spells.description: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moving faster for 3 seconds. The movement speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the ground beneath it, enemies on the scorched earth continue to take damage.

spells.name: Flame Breath
spells.description: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target marking them for 4 seconds. Basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum health as damage on-hit. Dragon Form: Flame Breath engulfs all units in a cone in front of her.

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.description: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location. Shyvana passively gains Armor and Magic Resistance. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.

passive.name: Essence Theft
passive.description: Gains a charge of Essence Theft whenever a spell hits an enemy. Upon reaching maximum charges, the next spell restores Ahri's Health.

spells.name: Orb of Deception
spells.description: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.

spells.name: Fox-Fire
spells.description: Ahri releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Charm
